data.summary: Reviews are overwhelmingly authentic. The company appears to deliver high-quality, custom pools but may struggle with project management, timelines, and communication during complex builds. Their post-construction warranty and service response is exceptionally strong, as evidenced by detailed positive reviews. The Yelp/Google discrepancy reflects platform bias and the nature of pool construction complaints rather than fake reviews.

positive_evidence: "not ONE time has Puryear failed to come out"
"continued to come back as many times as needed"

authentic_signals: Extremely specific project details (designers, PMs, timelines)
Mix of praise and constructive feedback (even 5-star reviews mention initial problems)
Emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
Named employees and specific warranty/service interactions
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google (4.5) and Yelp (3.3) show a notable rating gap. This is common in the pool industry where Yelp often attracts more critical reviews and Google is a primary platform for happy customers. The BBB A+ rating indicates strong complaint resolution, not service quality.

reviews.text:
Review update at ONE YEAR OF OPEN POOL SEASON:
I have had a few problems with everything working properly, but not ONE time has Puryear failed to come out, and they continued to come back as many times as needed to find the problem.  They also take total accountability for all problems and correct them right away.  It took a while to find the problem, but they have handled it 100% without issue.  All warranty work, 100% not an issue.  Would recommend Puryear again and again!
The entire crew is always very respectful, prompt and tolerate my crazy farm at each visit.

Updated review, we're complete!!  This was such a fun build and I'm so in love with our pool!  We've had water for a month now, and they are still very much involved with the process to make sure everything is the way it should be!  Thanks to George, the first tech that came out and taught us about part of the system.  He is very knowledgeable, proficient and professional!

Thank you, Puryear!

Excellent process so far!
reviews.author: Lindy Gerow

reviews.text: Puryear Custom Pools (PCP) from the get-go, listened to what we wanted and delivered where other companies designed what they wanted to instead.  Our goal was to add a pool/spa to our backyard and for it to be the centerpiece while the other companies wanted to add landscaping and throw a pool in.  We were under contract in December 2021 and by April 2022 we were filling with water.  We just completed our fourth summer with it and couldn't be happier with it and PCP.  Our only regret was not doing it sooner.  From design, to build to service, PCP has proven to be a professional organization that stands behind what they do.  If for ever reason we are in a position to build another pool, our first call is to PCP.    A special shout-out to Steve P., you're a rock-star.
reviews.author: Tim Mosich

reviews.text:
Puryear Pools exceeded all my expectations.  The customer service given by the entire team was over the top for my third pool.  The sales and design we experienced with Alex was not only a joy but we feel we have gained a friend.  Our builder Scott was always on site and scheduled our project seamlessly along with fantastic and professional subs. Josh in service handled pool set up with a plethora of knowledge for us in our first saltwater pool.  Also, Puryear’s office staff is not only attentive but follows through quickly and efficiently.  Hands down the best of our three pool experiences and we will confidently recommend Puryear to anyone who inquires.
Thank you Puryear Team for an outstanding experience!
reviews.author: Griffin Rambo

reviews.text:
We had a large backyard/pool remodel that broke ground 11/2023, and was slated to be completed in approximately 3-4 months. It was complex, and we picked this contractor because he assured us “my pencil is SHARP” and he would get things done and not nickel and dime us.

This guy was an utter disaster. Never seemed to be around, did not adequately supervise his crew, and the job site was always a mess. Damaged the cement on one of our terraces so we then had to retile all of the terraces. “Forgot” to remodel one of the retaining walls, so then we had to pay extra for that. Damaged the steps that he installed, used mismatched grout colors, did a horrendously sloppy job on tiling the pool waterline and coping stones, and the new pebble tec pool surface has multiple shades of blue and somehow brown. Did not properly plumb the waterfall and we had a leak out of a planter bed for months.  Never plumbed the overflow from the spa to the pool correctly and so we had a leak in that for months, that covered our steps in efflorescence and cracked the decking underneath. The stamped cool decking, which he assured us “lasts many many years” is cracked and crumbling after 1 year. I constantly had to police and supervise him, always calling out problems and errors.

Then this guy disappears after about 6 or 7 months. After calling the company multiple times they finally learned just how awful this sub contractor was and he is no longer with the company. I have subsequently worked with multiple members of their staff to redo and repair the majority of the job, but it is still not fully finished because of the failing cool decking. The staff that has been helping me in the last year have been gracious and understanding, and they have fixed almost everything that was done incorrectly, but I think some of it will just never be right (like the pool surface) and this is month 19.
reviews.author: Lindsey M

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Puryear pools. We interviewed 10+ companies and decided on them for their team (amazing!), quality, attention to detail and scale. From our first contact and appointment with Brandon (our designer) we were off to an amazing start. No pressure, highly skilled and wanted what we wanted....our dream pool, part 2! Brandon's patience know no bounds. Thank you, Brandon. We had Scott as our PM - Thank you Scott for everything. Scott worked tirelessly with all the contactors and answered all our questions (and measured 55K times with my Engineer Husband) and never lost patience. Thank you for all your hard work, Scott. And then there was William! William did pool school with us and so much more. William is capable of everything, has the patience of Job, is joyous to work with and will probably build his own pools at some point. William's communication and demeanor are unmatchable. He worked with us on all the last little details necessary. He was in our corner. Thank you, William! Puryear has an amazing process, amazing people and builds a beautiful custom pool. Thank you, Team Puryear!
reviews.author: Sue Austin

reviews.text: I wanted to give a 5 star review for our pool maintenance tech. Carlos has now been our guy for the last few months. He’s always on time and never misses a Thursday morning. Our pool has never looked better! He is a great kid and gives me hope for this generation of kids coming up. He stands out!!
reviews.author: allen low

reviews.text:
PURYEAR has been great since day 1 , Jimmy our pool designer came out I think the same day we called & said we have the perfect yard for a pool. Then I began explaining how I wanted my pool ( I am very particular how I like things done ).

We were given Mickey as a construction manager who went above and beyond for me!!! From re measuring things 5x and showing and explaining things to me every step of the way!

Our weekly cleaner I assume chase? He always comes and just leaves the door note, never knocks or lets me know he’s here ( I am sure he texts my husband but I am the one home ) there has been trash left in the yard. We did have a new weekly cleaner yesterday who went above and beyond Walter!!! HE WAS AMAZING 🤩 he cleaned my pool out, and then put chemicals & actually left the shock for me to do myself since my kids were in the pool. I have never met someone so nice and knowledgeable on everything he was doing. My kids are very talkative and never was he agitated or anything with them. Very nice kid.

I highly recommend this pool company to anyone looking they do amazing work
reviews.author: Melody Bandola

reviews.text: Puryear Pools built us a pool completed in 2021 and since then have done our serive and maintenance. They are easy to work with and very responsive. I especially like the new texting feature with the service dept. We love our pool so much and would highly recommend Puryear Pools.
reviews.author: Melissa Blair
